scientific_integrity: All-parameter proof gives an explicit integral dihedral basis using a contractible spoke-star core. Finite verification is supporting only; no unproved infinite extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Even spoke count n >=4; specified dihedral subgroup; homology representation, not equivariant homotopy. Priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
title: The integral dihedral homology lattice of even Möbius-ladder perfect-matching complexes
